About these 18 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Sunday has the most, with 7. The earliest start is Katy Morning Rides (Motherland Cycling Club) at 6:30 am; the latest is Tuesgay Social Ride at 7:30 pm. After work, 4 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 5 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 5. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
